FAQs

Is registration free?

Yes. Entry is free.

Is registration compulsory?

Yes. You need to register to attend.

Who can attend?

Newly entered (2026 batch) medical students from the Nizamabad Zone colleges listed on this page.

What is the purpose of the event?

To appreciate your efforts and help you begin your journey with proper guidance.

What should I expect?

An interactive session, Tarbiyah, academic guidance, quizzes and networking, along with the felicitation.

Where and when is it?

6 December 2026. Venue: Auditorium cum Seminar Hall, Knowledge Park International School, Yaqoob Pura, Bodhan Road, Nizamabad. Time: 9:30 AM – 2:00 PM.
